scope: developer and CLI toolset on the five fleet hosts; no credentials (brief: fleet-dev-toolset)
method: goals/cloud-agent-readiness/ops/fleet-dev-toolset survey: PATH resolution as the host's agent account, from inside its beep-effect checkout, with mise shims, ~/.local/bin, ~/.bun/bin, ~/.cargo/bin and Go bins prepended; origin classifies the resolved path (apt/mise/user/local). Presence is not authentication or runtime proof. Home paths are written as ~.

drift.dankserver: before: the worker checkout's mise.toml was untrusted, so every mise shim failed inside the checkout and node fell through to apt node v22; yq was Ubuntu's jq-wrapper yq 3.4.3
drift.beep-worker: the primary clone is stale (pins node 24 / bun 1.4.2) and was not touched; bootstrap ran from a fresh origin/main worktree
drift.grok-bot: /workspace/beep-effect is a stale clone (pins node 24 / bun 1.4.2); /usr/local bun 1.4.2 is root-owned image state, bootstrap's ~/.bun/bin bun 1.4.4 leads in login shells
